facts.value: Responsible for internal security, law enforcement, public order, traffic regulation, crime prevention, and investigative police work. HITL always required — never auto-route criminal or safety matters. Complaint domains encoded for routing: crime, theft, assault, public_disorder, traffic_accident, road_safety_threat, kidnapping, cybercrime, noise_threat.
